items.title: ONE WEEK TO GO: Connecting existing sustainability reporting with UK SRS
items.summary: With just one week to go, sustainability and reporting professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how businesses can connect existing ESOS, SECR and TCFD-aligned processes with emerging UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS).

items.title: TODAY: The Autumn Budget – How businesses can cut waste, control costs and prepare for 2027
items.summary: On 6 October, edie will host its latest webinar in partnership with JRP Solutions, exploring how businesses can cut waste, control costs and plan effectively for the year ahead.

items.title: From scrapping the Future Homes Standard to repealing the Climate Change Act: What the Conservatives’ economic plan means for the UK’s net-zero economy
items.summary: The Conservative Party’s shadow chancellor has announced plans to scrap a series of environmental and net-zero policies, including the Future Homes Standard and the Climate Change Act, as part of a wider programme of economic deregulation.

items.title: Business giants call for financial reforms to halt nature degradation
items.summary: More than 100 businesses and financial institutions have called on governments to kickstart a 12-month reform of subsidies and incentives that cause harm to nature and could impact long-term economic resilience, ahead of COP17 later this month.

items.title: Wind and solar helped UK avoid £5.9bn in gas imports during Hormuz crisis
items.summary: Record generation from wind and solar have allowed the UK to avoid £5.9bn in gas imports since the start of the Iran War, Carbon Brief analysis has revealed.

items.title: Government ignores wildfire plans as reservoir data is revealed
items.summary: As research reveals that UK reservoir storage is at half capacity across England, a freedom of information request has revealed that the Government has scrapped plans for wildfire prevention initiatives to be introduced.

items.title: First-ever ‘ecocide’ law for Latin America targets severe environmental destruction
items.summary: A coalition of legal scholars and environmental organisations has launched a model ecocide law for Latin America, providing national legislators with a framework for criminalising the most severe forms of environmental destruction.

items.title: Siegwerk Publishes Sustainability Report Based on Corporate Reporting Directive
items.summary: The first report of its kind reflects a voluntary step toward greater transparency and comparability in sustainability reporting.
